login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: The school issues your login and password.
login.noAccount: Logins and passwords are issued by the school office.
login.inactive: Your account is not active. Contact the school administrator.
login.passwordUpdated: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.
login.linkInvalid: The link is invalid or has expired.
login.loginHint: The school login (MT10001), your nickname, or your email address.
login.googleUnknown: Your email address has not been verified or accepted. Please contact us.
login.googleFailed: Signing in with Google did not complete. Try again, or sign in with your login and password.

password.rules: At least 10 characters, including letters and numbers.
password.keepCurrent: Leave empty to keep your current password.

verify.codeHint: The code from the email (6 digits).

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Enter the email of your account. We will send a code to confirm it is you.
reset.verifySubtitle: If an account exists for {email}, a code has been sent to it.
reset.passwordSubtitle: Choose a new password for your account.

pending.title: Request under review
pending.description: {name}, your registration request for {school} has been received. You will be able to sign in after the school approves it.
pending.rejectedDescription: The school has declined your registration request.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.signIn: By pressing the sign-in button you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms>. If you are under 18, this also confirms the consent of a parent or guardian.
terms.register: By continuing you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms>. If you are under 18, this also confirms the consent of a parent or guardian.
terms.pending: The official text has not been supplied yet. It will be published here as soon as the portal owner provides it.

school.chooseSubtitle: Signing in and registering happen at that school.

confirm.title: Confirm your email address
confirm.subtitle: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. Enter it below.
confirm.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
confirm.wrongAddress: If that address is wrong, ask the school office to correct it.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for МТМУ №7.
twoFactor.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Enter the new one from the app.
twoFactor.otherAccount: Sign out and use another account
twoFactor.lost: Lost your phone? Ask the school administration: they can switch two-step verification off.
